Per the task instructions, since no eligible profile has both a ready endpoint and a present implementation, no migration should be proposed at this time. Recommend first provisioning/confirming liboqs-0.16.0 on svc-eval-01 (and resolving unknown-readiness peers peer-01/03/05) before re-evaluating a migration to tls13-hybrid-x25519-mlkem768, which would otherwise be the preferred target given peer-02 and peer-04 readiness.
